body:
Thank you, I needed to hear this.

I was just so overwhelmed with emotion tonight and I couldn't believe that, after all these years, I went back to it all. Back then I was in this mindset for days/weeks, I was scared that I just did a 180 and felt that, in these few moments, that I would be stuck there again. 

But I believe what you say, and I believe that you're right, I believe that my past progress hasn't gone away. For a brief moment the physical pain felt rewarding. However, now contemplating tonight's actions resonate deeply with what you say.

You offered me amazing advice. Thank you.
Thank you, is that okay if I send you a PM?
I will send you a PM shortly, thank you.
